admission.justification: Dismissal persistence and UI feedback are a maintained cross-boundary obligation: treating optimistic removal as successful durable acknowledgement silently loses failed clicks. Native action/queue targets and separate bulk/failure/source-defined ASGI assertions establish the bounded contract, not a Curator runtime grade.

applicability: Individual and Clear-all acknowledgement for every published attention kind.
conditions: Requests use the current item id and a kind this build publishes.
An item the projection does not publish is refused as unknown, and a kind that disagrees with the published item is refused; no cause is refused for being live.
Clear all composes per-item requests for every current entry.
An unsuccessful reply restores the entry and reports that the acknowledgement did not hold.
Dismissing leaves the prompt unanswered, the held message held and the task's stage and seats unchanged.
exclusions: Dismissal of future occurrences of any kind.
Hiding an unacknowledged entry in client state.
statement: Every published attention entry - the three live native causes, the two terminal notice kinds and the surviving operational kinds - accepts one acknowledgement for its exact occurrence, while a failed write leaves the entry visible and an acknowledgement changes nothing at the cause.
